scope.market_definition: The Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) market encompasses the diagnosis, treatment, and management of this kidney disease characterized by scarring in the kidney's filtering units. Participants include pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, and various channel partners involved in distributing and providing services related to FSGS treatments globally.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the distribution of FSGS treatment products and services through various channel partners.

This layer involves system integrators that combine various treatment solutions for FSGS.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## Nephrology Clinics Serving Arizona

Southwest Kidney Institute offers more than treatment; we offer a care experience designed around
you. With 40+ offices statewide, our board-certified nephrology specialists provide advanced,
coordinated support for every stage of kidney disease, from early diagnosis to dialysis and
transplant.

#### Trusted Kidney Specialists in Arizona

Whether you’re facing chronic kidney disease, high blood pressure, kidney stones, or anemia, you’ll
find streamlined access to lab testing, imaging, and personalized care plans all in one place. Our
integrated treatment model means you won’t lose time navigating referrals; we’re already working
together behind the scenes.

As one of Arizona’s leading kidney care networks, our goal is to foster an environment in which
patients and their caregivers feel informed, supported, and in control of their treatment alongside
a trusted provider. We don’t just manage symptoms; we anticipate your needs and treat the whole
picture.

## Nephrology Clinics Serving Arizona

Southwest Kidney Institute offers more than treatment; we offer a care experience designed around
you. With 40+ offices statewide, our board-certified nephrology specialists provide advanced,
coordinated support for every stage of kidney disease, from early diagnosis to dialysis and
transplant.

#### Trusted Kidney Specialists in Arizona

Whether you’re facing chronic kidney disease, high blood pressure, kidney stones, or anemia, you’ll
find streamlined access to lab testing, imaging, and personalized care plans all in one place. Our
integrated treatment model means you won’t lose time navigating referrals; we’re already working
together behind the scenes.

As one of Arizona’s leading kidney care networks, our goal is to foster an environment in which
patients and their caregivers feel informed, supported, and in control of their treatment alongside
a trusted provider. We don’t just manage symptoms; we anticipate your needs and treat the whole
picture.

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced

across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# Creating a better world for everyone affected by rare, protein-spilling kidney disease

Rare kidney disease (RKD) touches thousands of lives across the globe every day. NephCure is shaping
the future of RKD by empowering patients to take charge of their health, while leading the
revolution in research, new treatments, and care. Together, we’re helping everyone affected by RKD
thrive—and each day, getting one step closer to a cure.

[GET INVOLVED][57] [WHAT WE DO][58]

## Diagnosed with a rare, protein-spilling kidney disease? You’re not alone.

If you or a loved one is coping with FSGS, IgA nephropathy, or another nephrotic syndrome, the path
forward doesn’t always seem clear. No matter where you are in your journey, NephCure is here to
support you, and connect you with the right tools, resources, and care.

stay current, confident, and connected in an evolving profession.

Nefrología (English Edition)
[[Nefrología (English Edition)]][41]
ISSN: 2013-2514

Nefrología is the official publication of the Spanish Society of Nephrology. The Journal publishes
articles on basic or clinical research relating to nephrology, arterial hypertension, dialysis and
kidney transplants. It is governed by the peer review system and all original papers are subject to
internal assessment and external reviews. The journal accepts submissions of articles in English and
in Spanish languages. Nefrología follows the publication requirements of the International Committee
of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE) and the Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE).

Nefrología is a Diamond Open Access journal: it charges no article processing charges (APCs) to
authors and no access fees to readers. It is open to authors of any affiliation, country or status.
Publishing costs are fully covered by the Spanish Society of Nephrology (SEN).

Nefrología is owned by the Spanish Society of Nephrology (SEN), a not-for-profit scientific society.
Elsevier provides editorial and production services only; content and editorial decisions rest with
the SEN and the journal's Editorial Board.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Our Core Capabilities

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Who We Are

**Travere Therapeutics is a patient-centered biopharmaceutical company that stands with rare disease
communities every step of the way.**

Our mission extends beyond developing therapies—we are deeply committed to supporting patients,
caregivers, and advocates through meaningful partnerships that foster education, connection, and
hope. From the pre-clinical stage onward, we engage directly with the communities we serve to
understand their needs and co-create solutions that make a difference in their lives.

### Living with cystic fibrosis
### is complicated

Work with a CF patient mentor to overcome your disease and achieve your goals.

[Book A Session][2]

###### Connect

Connect with a mentor who has walked in your shoes and succeeded.

###### Talk

Talk through your situation and how to win the battles you're fighting.

###### Improve

Implement strategies to improve your health and achieve your goals.

#### For me this is personal

###### I'm Caleb Freeman. I have spent the past 35 years trying to overcome my disease and build a
###### life for myself.
###### 
###### I have a successful career, helped build and exit a startup, I'm married, own a home, and
###### have 2 kids. None of these things are easy today, and with a disease like CF they may seem
###### impossible.
###### 
###### I'm here to tell you that they are possible, even with CF. We work directly with adult CFers
###### and parents of young CFers to help you achieve your goals.

#### Let's tackle your biggest obstacles together

###### Recently Diagnosed

Make sense of a new diagnosis.

###### Adult Transition

Learn how to step out on your own.

###### Building a Career

Launch a career and navigate the workplace.

###### Dating

Juggling chronic disease and relationships.

###### Fatigue & Brain Fog

Improve focus, energy, and productivity.

###### Disease Management

How to save time and improve your health.

## Restoring Health, Transforming Lives Through Innovation

ZyVersa is committed to improving health outcomes and quality of life for patients with inflammatory
and renal diseases

## Inflammasomes

Inflammasomes are molecular complexes that activate the innate immune system. Although the immune
system is critical for health, excessive and/or chronic activation can result in inflammatory
diseases. ZyVersa is developing IC 100, a novel monoclonal antibody that inhibits a component of the
inflammasome (adaptor ASC) to block initiation and perpetuation of the inflammatory cascade.

[Learn more][38]

## Renal Lipids

Although cholesterol is critical for healthy cells, in chronic kidney diseases excess cholesterol
accumulates in the kidney's filtration system due to impaired transport out of the cells. This
impairs the structure and function, resulting in protein spillage into the urine. ZyVersa is
developing VAR 200, a cholesterol efflux mediator that removes excess cholesterol from the kidney's
filtration system to protect against structural damage, reduce proteinuria, and preserve function.

[Learn More][39]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

### Market Signals

### Strategic Insights

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by

trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

caregivers, and advocates through meaningful partnerships that foster education, connection, and
hope. From the pre-clinical stage onward, we engage directly with the communities we serve to
understand their needs and co-create solutions that make a difference in their lives.

### Living with cystic fibrosis
### is complicated

Work with a CF patient mentor to overcome your disease and achieve your goals.

[Book A Session][2]

###### Connect

Connect with a mentor who has walked in your shoes and succeeded.

###### Talk

Talk through your situation and how to win the battles you're fighting.

###### Improve

Implement strategies to improve your health and achieve your goals.

#### For me this is personal

###### I'm Caleb Freeman. I have spent the past 35 years trying to overcome my disease and build a
###### life for myself.
###### 
###### I have a successful career, helped build and exit a startup, I'm married, own a home, and
###### have 2 kids. None of these things are easy today, and with a disease like CF they may seem
###### impossible.
###### 
###### I'm here to tell you that they are possible, even with CF. We work directly with adult CFers
###### and parents of young CFers to help you achieve your goals.

#### Let's tackle your biggest obstacles together

###### Recently Diagnosed

Make sense of a new diagnosis.

###### Adult Transition

Learn how to step out on your own.

###### Building a Career

Launch a career and navigate the workplace.

###### Dating

Juggling chronic disease and relationships.

###### Fatigue & Brain Fog

Improve focus, energy, and productivity.

###### Disease Management

How to save time and improve your health.

Are you a parent of a CFer?

### My childhood was rough. Your CFer's childhood doesn't have to be.

We work with parents to support the entire family and avoid common problems when raising a CFer.

## Restoring Health, Transforming Lives Through Innovation

ZyVersa is committed to improving health outcomes and quality of life for patients with inflammatory
and renal diseases

## Inflammasomes

Inflammasomes are molecular complexes that activate the innate immune system. Although the immune
system is critical for health, excessive and/or chronic activation can result in inflammatory
diseases. ZyVersa is developing IC 100, a novel monoclonal antibody that inhibits a component of the
inflammasome (adaptor ASC) to block initiation and perpetuation of the inflammatory cascade.

[Learn more][38]

## Renal Lipids

Although cholesterol is critical for healthy cells, in chronic kidney diseases excess cholesterol
accumulates in the kidney's filtration system due to impaired transport out of the cells. This
impairs the structure and function, resulting in protein spillage into the urine. ZyVersa is
developing VAR 200, a cholesterol efflux mediator that removes excess cholesterol from the kidney's
filtration system to protect against structural damage, reduce proteinuria, and preserve function.

## Restoring Health, Transforming Lives Through Innovation

ZyVersa is committed to improving health outcomes and quality of life for patients with inflammatory
and renal diseases

## Inflammasomes

Inflammasomes are molecular complexes that activate the innate immune system. Although the immune
system is critical for health, excessive and/or chronic activation can result in inflammatory
diseases. ZyVersa is developing IC 100, a novel monoclonal antibody that inhibits a component of the
inflammasome (adaptor ASC) to block initiation and perpetuation of the inflammatory cascade.

[Learn more][38]

## Renal Lipids

Although cholesterol is critical for healthy cells, in chronic kidney diseases excess cholesterol
accumulates in the kidney's filtration system due to impaired transport out of the cells. This
impairs the structure and function, resulting in protein spillage into the urine. ZyVersa is
developing VAR 200, a cholesterol efflux mediator that removes excess cholesterol from the kidney's
filtration system to protect against structural damage, reduce proteinuria, and preserve function.

[Learn More][39]
